Information for Tenderer/Consultant :
Eligibility of Tenderer : This invitation for Tender is open to all eligible Reputed Supplier/Tenderer as mentioned below as further detailed in the Tender
Data Sheet (TDS) of the Tender Document.
a) The minimum number of years of the general experience of the Supplier/Tenderer in the electro-mechanical works shall be five
(05) years.
b) The minimum specific experience of the Supplier/Tenderer at least 01(One) contract of similar nature of works (Supply and
Installation of Sub-station minimum capacity 800 KVA) successfully completed within the last five (5) years (Years/Date counting
backward from the date of publication of IFT in the e-GP system) with a value of at least Tk. 46000000 (Four Crore and sixty Lakh
) or 02(Two) contract with summation of value at least Tk. 52000000 (Five Crore and Twenty Lakh) only Government/ Semi-
Government/ Autonomous Bodies /Private within Bangladesh. The issued Private Certificate must be authenticated (verified) by
the Executive Engineer of PWD within his jurisdiction.
c)The minimum amount of Liquid Assets or Working Capital or Letter of Commitment for Bank’s Undertaking for a line of credit as
per Form PG3-8 of Tender and Contract Forms must be submitted for this purpose of the successful Tenderer shall not be less
than Tk. 52000000 (Five Crore and Twenty Lakh) only. The Supporting Bank Document submitted along with the Tender must be
issued between the Publication date & Submission date of the Tender.
d) Supplier/Tenderer must have an up-to-date ABC category Contractor License (License must be issued in favor of his own
organization) & Electrical Supervisory Certificate from Bangladesh Electrical Licensing Board.
